'''Twilight Taverna''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located just off [[Ploughtekal Market]], a multi-level market situated within the [[Zi-Kree Sector]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The cantina was in operation during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
